summary: Multi-party cargo insurance settlement under heterogeneous ICC clauses, deductibles, exclusions and sub-limits. Capacity-folded checks: setup_gate (structural/format plumbing) + 5x customer_settled::<ID> (per-customer settlement, R3a — each = AND of gross / paid / reduction / status / 3 reason-keyword tiers) + summary_consistent (aggregate totals + counts + container cap guard).

checks.description: Plumbing/format gate (R2): outputs/insurance_settlement.json exists and is non-empty, parses as a JSON object with top-level 'settlements' (array) and 'summary' (object), settlements[] has exactly 5 entries, and the summary object has all required keys (total_gross_claim_usd, total_paid_usd, total_reduction_usd, count_paid, count_denied, count_no_claim, container_cap_check). Internally folds the 4 structural atoms; failing atoms listed in reason.

LINNEA settled correctly (R3a, AND of 7 dimensions): gross_claim_usd 12800.00 (±0.50), paid_usd 12300.00 (±0.50, gross minus USD 500 absolute deductible under ICC(A)), reduction_from_claim_usd 500.00 (±0.50), status 'paid_partial', and reason_short cites coverage scope (icc(a)/all-risks), deductible figure (usd 500/absolute deductible), and a policy specific (pingan/26,400/sum insured/no exclusion). Failing dimensions listed in reason.

JONAS settled correctly (R3a, AND of 7 dimensions): gross_claim_usd 0.00 (±0.50, top-tier cartons zero damage), paid_usd 0.00, reduction_from_claim_usd 0.00, status 'no_claim', and reason_short notes absence of loss, the policy basis (allianz/icc(b)/fob), and stow/carton facts (top tier/rubber gasket/8 cartons dry). Failing dimensions listed in reason.

MAHMOUD settled correctly (R3a, AND of 7 dimensions): gross_claim_usd 26100.00 (±0.50), paid_usd 0.00 (Sinosure SC-NFT-2024-Rev3 natural-fibre textile moisture exclusion applies; no-gross-negligence finding means override not met), reduction_from_claim_usd 26100.00, status 'denied' or 'escalate_surveyor' (list-acceptable), and reason_short cites the natural-fibre/textile exclusion, the gross-negligence override / surveyor finding, and an insurer/rider identifier (sinosure/sc-nft/rev3). Failing dimensions listed in reason.

OCEANTECH settled correctly (R3a, AND of 7 dimensions): gross_claim_usd 5400.00 (±0.50, 6 cartons at 30% of USD 3000), paid_usd 0.00 (ICC(C) named perils exclude ordinary water damage in transit; no grounding/sinking/collision/jettison), reduction_from_claim_usd 5400.00, status 'denied' (named-perils gap not curable by surveyor evidence), and reason_short cites the ICC(C) named-perils basis, the coverage-gap reasoning, and insurer/scope details (baoviet/ordinary water/icc(b) would cover). Failing dimensions listed in reason.

VERDE settled correctly (R3a, AND of 7 dimensions): gross_claim_usd 7200.00 (±0.50), paid_usd 2000.00 (MF-SUB-2025-08 per-event sub-limit of USD 2,000 caps the payout; no deductible under primer-comprador programme), reduction_from_claim_usd 5200.00, status 'paid_partial', and reason_short cites the per-event sub-limit, mapfre/clause/no-deductible, and aggregation/cap mechanics (single event/5,200/capped). Failing dimensions listed in reason.

Aggregate roll-up consistent (R1, AND of 6 atoms): summary.total_gross_claim_usd 51500.00 (±5.00), total_paid_usd 14300.00 (±5.00), total_reduction_usd 37200.00 (±5.00), count_paid equals 2 (paid_full + paid_partial), count_denied equals 2 (denied + escalate_surveyor), and container_cap_check is true (total_paid <= 130,000). Failing atoms listed in reason.
